intro.text: A lighteyed lady on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Melali was with Relis Ruthar when Adolin challenged him for his Shardblade. Bitter toward Adolin, she mocked him and Dalinar, saying she was surprised Dalinar finally let him duel in case he hurt himself. When Adolin asked after her sister, she told him the sister was off limits; Adolin remembered that her sister was why Melali despised him.

appearance.text: Adolin thinks her quite pretty. She wears a traditional Vorin havah and complex braids held with hairspikes.
